properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.rs watch_refutations / refuted_since; MCP service.rs watch_attacks / with_now_refuted). review_relations, create_edge, add_requirement and add_constraint read, before the write, every record the write's CONTRADICTS links (and the written node's own) attack, and reply `now_refuted` for each the write turned refuted, defeated or conceded: what holds against it, why, and for a claim `keep_as_dispute` (draw a CONTRADICTS back, or a contested Decision). Since phase 6 PR 4 (2026-10-20, service.rs bulk_result_refuting, bulk_edges.rs ids_named): create_edges watches its CONTRADICTS targets, draw_edges every record an item names and what each attacks (documenting a recalled counterexample's source turns it into a refutation, and the reply says so), and add_decision's related_to its CONTRADICTS links.
properties.name: A write that turns a claim refuted, or a step defeated, says so in its reply, with how to keep a dispute instead
